description: Search Riviera Maya Elite’s directory of local businesses: over 2,000 in Playa del Carmen plus curated picks for Akumal and Cancún. Filter by free text (name, type, neighbourhood — e.g. "tacos centro", "dentist", "boat tours"), category and area. Returns name, type, neighbourhood, a map link, the business website when it is a featured business, and a link for owners to claim or correct the listing.

featured_only.description: Only featured businesses (they have a website).

lang.description: Language for labels and links: "en" (default) or "es".

query.description: What to look for, e.g. "seafood", "yoga", "car rental", or a business name.

name: search_directory
title: Search the local business directory
